replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Well since you did claim that you were ParaPot, it also means that you were ban evading. Meaning that you were evading your ban on ParaPot by going on a different account.

"I am asking to get unbanned from parapet so i don't get falsely banned if i do get unbanned."

You should have made an appeal on the account ParaPot instead of going on your current account. Unfortunately, both of your accounts will remain banned as you have to face the consequences for your actions.

You may next create an appeal regarding this situation in 5-7 months as it is currently denied.
